theme: The night they still talk about

linkedin.text:
Ask anyone what they remember from a company trip and you will get one night, not five days.

This is that night, from an event we produced: full room, lights up, and about four hundred people who stopped being colleagues for a couple of hours.

The design of that evening is not luck. It is a running order. The room has to fill fast rather than trickle, the first forty minutes have to give people something to do with their hands, and the moment the floor opens has to arrive before the room cools rather than after dessert. Get the sequence wrong and the same budget produces a polite dinner.

That sequencing is most of what we actually sell. The venue is the easy part.

Want one night people still reference next year? Tell us what the company is celebrating.

Uproduction Events — From Business to Pleasure
